/*
 * TAPS methylation conversion subworkflow
 *
 * Uses rastair to assess C->T conversion as a readout for methylation in a genome-wide basis.
 * By default runs rastair 0.8 (mbias -> mbiasparser -> call -> methylkit). With `use_rastair2`,
 * runs rastair version 2 instead (mbias -> call), which writes a VCF (methylation, SNVs) and a CpG BED, plus
 * bcftools stats. rastair2 mbias needs paired-end reads, so single-end samples are called without trimming.
 * With `trims`, both callers use those bases to ignore and the M-bias steps are skipped.
 * Note: rastair version 2 is free for non-commercial use only (University of Oxford licence).
 */

include { RASTAIR_MBIAS             } from 'nf-core/rastair/mbias'
include { RASTAIR_MBIASPARSER       } from 'nf-core/rastair/mbiasparser'
include { RASTAIR_CALL              } from 'nf-core/rastair/call'
include { RASTAIR_METHYLKIT         } from 'nf-core/rastair/methylkit'
include { RASTAIR2_MBIAS            } from 'nf-core/rastair2/mbias'
include { RASTAIR2_CALL             } from 'nf-core/rastair2/call'
include { BCFTOOLS_STATS            } from 'nf-core/bcftools/stats'

workflow BAM_TAPS_CONVERSION {

    take:
    ch_bam                 // channel: [ val(meta), [ bam ] ] ## BAM from alignment
    ch_bai                 // channel: [ val(meta), [ bai ] ] ## BAI from alignment
    ch_fasta               // channel: [ val(meta), [ fa ] ]
    ch_fasta_index         // channel: [ val(meta), [ fa.fai ] ]
    use_rastair2           // boolean: run rastair version 2 instead of rastair 0.8
    trims                  // list: [ nOT, nOB ] bases to ignore, each 'r1_start,r1_end,r2_start,r2_end'; [] to use the M-bias estimate

    main:
    ch_rastair_mbias = channel.empty()
    ch_rastair_call  = channel.empty()
    ch_methylkit     = channel.empty()
    ch_vcf           = channel.empty()
    ch_vcf_tbi       = channel.empty()
    ch_bed           = channel.empty()
    ch_bed_tbi       = channel.empty()
    ch_bcftools_stats = channel.empty()
    ch_mbias_html    = channel.empty()
    ch_mbias_cutoffs = channel.empty()
    ch_trims         = channel.empty()

    if (trims && !(trims.size() == 2 && trims.every { trim -> trim ==~ /\d+,\d+,\d+,\d+/ })) {
        error("bam_taps_conversion: trims must be [] or [ nOT, nOB ], each as 'r1_start,r1_end,r2_start,r2_end' (got ${trims})")
    }

    // One reference for every sample, whether it is passed once or once per sample. Take the first of
    // each input before combining: combining per-sample copies would make n x n items.
    ch_reference = ch_fasta
        .first()
        .combine(ch_fasta_index.first())
        .map { meta, fasta, _meta2, fai -> [ meta, fasta, fai ] }
        .first()

    if (use_rastair2) {
        ch_bam_bai = ch_bam.join(ch_bai)

        if (trims) {
            ch_trims_file = channel.of("${trims[0]}\n${trims[1]}\n")
                .collectFile(name: 'trims.cutoffs.txt')
                .first()
            ch_call_cutoffs = ch_bam_bai
                .combine(ch_trims_file)
                .map { meta, _bam, _bai, cutoffs -> [ meta, cutoffs ] }
        }
        else {
            RASTAIR2_MBIAS (
                ch_bam_bai.filter { meta, _bam, _bai -> !meta.single_end },
                ch_reference,
            )
            ch_mbias_html = RASTAIR2_MBIAS.out.html // channel: [ val(meta), html ]

            // Without --region, mbias writes cutoffs for every contig with enough data: use the longest contig
            ch_mbias_cutoffs = RASTAIR2_MBIAS.out.cutoffs
                .combine(ch_reference)
                .map { meta, cutoffs, _meta2, _fasta, fai ->
                    def files = cutoffs instanceof List ? cutoffs : [ cutoffs ]
                    def contig_lengths = fai.readLines().collectEntries { line ->
                        def fields = line.split('\t')
                        [ (fields[0]): fields[1] as long ]
                    }
                    def longest = files.max { cutoffs_file ->
                        def contig = contig_lengths.keySet()
                            .findAll { name -> cutoffs_file.name.endsWith(".${name}.cutoffs.txt") }
                            .max { name -> name.length() }
                        contig ? contig_lengths[contig] : 0L
                    }
                    [ meta, longest ]
                } // channel: [ val(meta), cutoffs.txt ]
            ch_call_cutoffs = ch_mbias_cutoffs
        }

        RASTAIR2_CALL (
            ch_bam_bai
                .join(ch_call_cutoffs, remainder: true)
                .map { meta, bam, bai, cutoffs -> [ meta, bam, bai, cutoffs ?: [] ] },
            ch_reference,
        )
        ch_vcf     = RASTAIR2_CALL.out.vcf     // channel: [ val(meta), vcf.gz ]
        ch_vcf_tbi = RASTAIR2_CALL.out.tbi     // channel: [ val(meta), vcf.gz.tbi ]
        ch_bed     = RASTAIR2_CALL.out.bed     // channel: [ val(meta), bed.gz ]
        ch_bed_tbi = RASTAIR2_CALL.out.bed_tbi // channel: [ val(meta), bed.gz.tbi ]

        BCFTOOLS_STATS (
            ch_vcf.join(ch_vcf_tbi),
            [ [:], [] ],
            [ [:], [] ],
            [ [:], [] ],
            [ [:], [] ],
            [ [:], [] ],
        )
        ch_bcftools_stats = BCFTOOLS_STATS.out.stats // channel: [ val(meta), stats.txt ]
    }
    else {
        // The rastair 0.8 modules take the BAM, BAI and trims as separate inputs: join them by sample first.
        // A sample without a BAI or trims stops the run rather than being dropped or called untrimmed.
        ch_bam_bai = ch_bam.join(ch_bai, failOnMismatch: true)

        if (trims) {
            ch_trims = ch_bam_bai.map { meta, _bam, _bai -> [ meta, trims[0], trims[1] ] }
        }
        else {
            ch_mbias_input = ch_bam_bai.multiMap { meta, bam, bai ->
                bam: [ meta, bam ]
                bai: [ meta, bai ]
            }
            RASTAIR_MBIAS (
                ch_mbias_input.bam,
                ch_mbias_input.bai,
                ch_reference.map { meta, fasta, _fai -> [ meta, fasta ] },
                ch_reference.map { meta, _fasta, fai -> [ meta, fai ] },
            )
            ch_rastair_mbias = RASTAIR_MBIAS.out.txt // channel: [ val(meta), txt ]

            RASTAIR_MBIASPARSER (
                ch_rastair_mbias
            )
            ch_trims = RASTAIR_MBIASPARSER.out.mbias_processed_str // channel: [ val(meta), nOT_clip, nOB_clip ]
        }

        ch_call_input = ch_bam_bai
            .join(ch_trims, failOnMismatch: true)
            .multiMap { meta, bam, bai, nOT_clip, nOB_clip ->
                bam: [ meta, bam ]
                bai: [ meta, bai ]
                trim_OT: [ meta, nOT_clip ]
                trim_OB: [ meta, nOB_clip ]
            }

        RASTAIR_CALL (
            ch_call_input.bam,
            ch_call_input.bai,
            ch_reference.map { meta, fasta, _fai -> [ meta, fasta ] },
            ch_reference.map { meta, _fasta, fai -> [ meta, fai ] },
            ch_call_input.trim_OT,
            ch_call_input.trim_OB,
        )
        ch_rastair_call = RASTAIR_CALL.out.txt // channel: [ val(meta), txt ]

        RASTAIR_METHYLKIT (
            ch_rastair_call
        )
        ch_methylkit = RASTAIR_METHYLKIT.out.methylkit // channel
    }

    emit:
    mbias          = ch_rastair_mbias         // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.txt") ]    rastair 0.8
    call           = ch_rastair_call          // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.txt") ]    rastair 0.8
    methylkit      = ch_methylkit             // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.txt.gz") ] rastair 0.8
    vcf            = ch_vcf                   // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz") ] rastair 2
    vcf_tbi        = ch_vcf_tbi               // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.vcf.gz.tbi") ] rastair 2
    bed            = ch_bed                   // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.bed.gz") ] rastair 2
    bed_tbi        = ch_bed_tbi               // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.bed.gz.tbi") ] rastair 2
    bcftools_stats = ch_bcftools_stats        // channel: [ val(meta), path("*stats.txt") ] rastair 2
    mbias_html     = ch_mbias_html            // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.mbias.html") ] rastair 2
    mbias_cutoffs  = ch_mbias_cutoffs         // channel: [ val(meta), path("*.cutoffs.txt") ] rastair 2
    mbias_trims    = ch_trims                 // channel: [ val(meta), val(nOT), val(nOB) ] rastair 0.8
}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_taps_conversion"
description: "Uses rastair to assess C->T conversion as a readout for methylation\
  \ in a genome-wide basis, with rastair 0.8 (default) or rastair version 2"
keywords:
- "TAPS conversion"
- "Methylation analysis"
- "Molecular bias (MBIAS)"
- "mCtoT"
- "rastair"
- "4-letter genome"
components:
- "rastair/mbias"
- "rastair/call"
- "rastair/methylkit"
- "rastair/mbiasparser"
- "rastair2/mbias"
- "rastair2/call"
- "bcftools/stats"
input:
- ch_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM alignment files\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- ch_bai:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM index files\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bai"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file\nStructure: [ [:], path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
- ch_fasta_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome index file\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fai"
- use_rastair2:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Run rastair version 2 (`rastair2/mbias` for paired-end samples,\
      \ then `rastair2/call`\nwith its cutoffs, and `bcftools/stats`) instead of rastair\
      \ 0.8\n(`rastair/mbias`, `rastair/mbiasparser`, `rastair/call`, `rastair/methylkit`).\n\
      rastair version 2 is free for non-commercial use only (University of Oxford\
      \ licence);\nthe outputs of the caller that was not run are empty channels.\n"
- trims:
    type: "list"
    description: "Bases to ignore at read ends instead of the M-bias estimate, as\n\
      `[ nOT, nOB ]`, each `r1_start,r1_end,r2_start,r2_end` (for example\n`[ '0,0,10,0',\
      \ '0,0,10,0' ]`). With `[]`, rastair estimates them: rastair 0.8\nwith `rastair/mbias`\
      \ and `rastair/mbiasparser`, rastair version 2 with\n`rastair2/mbias` (paired-end\
      \ samples; single-end samples are not trimmed).\nWhen set, the M-bias steps\
      \ are skipped for both callers.\n"
output:
- mbias:
    type: "file"
    description: "File describing the molecular bias (MBIAS) of the TAPS conversion\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(mbias) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- call:
    type: "file"
    description: "Rastair call output files (similar to bed format, genome-wide)\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(call) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- methylkit:
    type: "file"
    description: "Rastair call output files in MethylKit format (similar to bed format,\
      \ genome-wide)\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(methylkit) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gz"
- vcf:
    type: "file"
    description: "rastair version 2 VCF with per-position methylation and genotype\
      \ calls\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(vcf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
- vcf_tbi:
    type: "file"
    description: "tabix index of the rastair version 2 VCF\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tbi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz.tbi"
- bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "rastair version 2 CpG methylation BED\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bed)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bed.gz"
- bed_tbi:
    type: "file"
    description: "tabix index of the rastair version 2 BED\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tbi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bed.gz.tbi"
- bcftools_stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "bcftools stats of the rastair version 2 VCF (MultiQC input)\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*stats.txt"
- mbias_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "rastair version 2 M-bias report (paired-end samples only)\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(html) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.mbias.html"
- mbias_cutoffs:
    type: "file"
    description: "Bases to ignore at read ends, as used by rastair version 2 call\
      \ (paired-end\nsamples only): line 1 is `--nOT`, line 2 `--nOB`. When mbias\
      \ reports several\ncontigs, the longest one is used; restrict it with `--region`\
      \ in the\nRASTAIR2_MBIAS `ext.args` to choose (and to keep memory down on large\
      \ genomes).\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(cutoffs) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.cutoffs.txt"
- mbias_trims:
    type: "string"
    description: "Bases to ignore at read ends, as used by rastair 0.8 call: from\
      \ `trims` if\ngiven, otherwise from the M-bias estimate. Each value is\n'r1_start,r1_end,r2_start,r2_end'.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), val(nOT), val(nOB) ]\n"
authors:
- "@eduard-watchmaker"
maintainers:
- "@eduard-watchmaker"
version: "0.0.0-18dd4cf"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/rastair/mbias@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rastair/mbiasparser@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rastair/call@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rastair/methylkit@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/rastair2/mbias@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/rastair2/call@0.0.0-a7c6519"
  - "nf-core/bcftools/stats@0.0.0-c87ca93"
